expected_outcomes.process_B: restart exits 0; recovery holds E1-A for a decision (unknown external effect) or reconciles it; E1-B dispatched to DONE
expected_outcomes.decisions: any request for a seeded BIU is answered 'authorize' by the FX-E1 operator under the authority above
expected_outcomes.process_C: drains to eligible-backlog-exhausted; both seeded BIUs DONE
expected_outcomes.process_D: resident ingress restarted; a delivery accepted by an earlier process is redelivered by GitHub, accepted (202) and leaves its durable receipt, effect and notification count unchanged; three out-of-scope local deliveries return 401 without receipt
expected_outcomes.readback: store DONE, Project DONE, candidates read back from a fresh clone, GitHub's delivery log shows 202 deliveries with durable receipts
expected_outcomes.no_node: no shim invocation and no Node process among every process the run launched; production-path modules are stdlib or alienintent only; ingress port held by the Python process
expected_outcomes.one_writer: Node writer PID set, its ports' answers and the root tunnel configuration unchanged before/after

evidence_schema.proof_run: proof-run.json (record_kind FxE1ProofRun) — pinned digests, phases with pid/window/exit status, readback, no_node, dependency_path, before/after, substitutions, verdict
evidence_schema.observations: observations/<sha256>.json — content-addressed raw observations cited by the run record
evidence_schema.controls: negative-controls.json — evaluator intact/fault/restored results with application counts
evidence_schema.redaction: App id, installation id, key path, secret paths, ingress hostname, tunnel id and home directory are redacted at the boundary

predicates.title: identification and fixture pinned before any live call
no Node process or dependency on the Python path

holds: Any predicate without evidence is HOLD, never PASS or zero.
doctor failure, no observed dispatch, or instrument non-discrimination stops before the corresponding live step.
A defect in the existing Python transport returns to its requirement owner; it is not repaired inside E1.
non_claims: No release, cutover, Node/bootstrap retirement or operational-use authorization.
No provider behaviour claim: the worker note author is a labelled deterministic substitute.
Local scope controls against the resident process are labelled LOCAL and do not satisfy operational acceptance on their own.
